notes: Reviewed the BSB disagreement on the directive he of הַחוּצָה. The ASV spends one English word, without, on the form, so the he fuses with its stem under rule 30 rather than standing unrepresented beside it, matching מַעְלָה → above at 1KI.7.31 and מִלְמַעְלָה at 1KI.7.11. The article keeps its own unrepresented unit under the 1KI.8.51 convention, since the ASV writes no the for the phrase.
